post.title: Wishlist or Surprise? Pause and Pick #shorts
post.description: Which did you pick: wishlist or surprise? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who never buys off the list. Leo skips the wishlist to find something 'thoughtful'. In 'Give them what they want: The benefits of explicitness in gift exchange' (Journal of Experimental Social Psychology, 2011), Francesca Gino and Francis Flynn found across five experiments that people appreciated gifts they had asked for more than unrequested ones, and saw them as more thoughtful, while givers expected the opposite. Listening is the thoughtful part. #psychology #shorts #gifts #giftideas #overthinking
